About us: 

TYH Boutique is a Canadian based, family-owned and operated business specializing in women’s fashion. We take pride in offering a curated selection of world-renowned brands, including Joseph Ribkoff, Frank Lyman, Charlie B, Dolcezza, CompliK, and UP! Pants.

How to promote us:

TYH Boutique offers complimentary shipping on all orders, along with free returns across the USA and Canada. Benefit from our lowest price guarantee and shop with confidence knowing all orders are delivered duty- and tariff-free. Experience secure, seamless shopping with the latest in privacy protection.

Discover the largest online selection of Joseph Ribkoff and Frank Lyman women’s designer collections, featuring an extensive range of high-quality, Canadian-made pieces. At TYH Boutique, we curate distinctive, boutique-style exclusives you won’t find anywhere else. Our online store also includes a very large sale selection where you can indulge in designer clothing for great discounts. 

Sign-up to our newsletter to benefit from a mystery discount on your first order and be the first to know about our promotions and special events. A few times/year we offer FREE designer gifts with purchase. 

Only promote 2 brands:

You will represent two distinguished Canadian brands alongside TYH Boutique: Joseph Ribkoff and Frank Lyman, both loved for their refined collections, with most pieces crafted in Canada.

Affiliates are required to ensure that all promotional content aligns accurately with the corresponding brand and landing page. Content featuring Joseph Ribkoff must direct customers to Joseph Ribkoff-specific landing pages, and likewise, Frank Lyman content must link exclusively to Frank Lyman pages. Mixing brand assets—such as promoting Frank Lyman products while directing traffic to a Joseph Ribkoff page—is strictly prohibited. Maintaining this consistency is essential to preserve brand integrity, ensure a seamless customer experience, and uphold the standards of the TYH Boutique affiliate program. We have provided 4 different collections to promote, Joseph Ribkoff New Arrivals, Joseph Ribkoff Essentials, Frank Lyman Best Sellers and Frank Lyman New Arrivals. Each collection has its own Video(s), Images and Landing page clearly identified in the media section.
payout_period: We will pay affiliated on the 1st of the month.
